## Edgewise Therapeutics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 24, 2026


BOULDER, Colo.


, Nov. 24, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: EWTX), a leading clinical-stage cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, today announced that management will participate in the following investor conferences:


**9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference** **Fireside chat:** Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 2:35 pm ET


**Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference** **Fireside chat:** Wednesday, December 2, 2026 at 10:30 am ET


The webcasts can be found on the Edgewise[Events & Presentations page](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4829502-1&h=1152911473&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.edgewisetx.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=Events+%26+Presentations+page) and will be accessible for replay, for a limited time, following the conferences. It is recommended that users connect to the live webcast several minutes prior to the start to ensure a timely connection.


**About Edgewise Therapeutics**


Edgewise Therapeutics is a cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapies intended to address cardiac equilibrium, the balance of contraction and relaxation across the cardiac cycle. Drawing on deep expertise in integrated muscle physiology and small molecule drug development, Edgewise is advancing novel therapies intended to fine-tune cardiac muscle function and improve treatment options for people with symptomatic hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and heart failure. To learn more, go to[edgewisetx.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4829502-1&h=3782732321&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedgewisetx.com%2F&a=edgewisetx.com%C2%A0) or follow Edgewise on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4829502-1&h=2633764315&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fedgewisetx&a=LinkedIn) and[X](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4829502-1&h=1860355017&u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FEdgewiseTx&a=X) .
